description: This file contains unit tests for functions related to usage normalization and token counting, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: normalizeUsage
methods.description: Normalizes usage objects, converting various token count formats into a standardized object with input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite, and total tokens.

methods.name: hasNonzeroUsage
methods.description: Checks if a usage object has any non-zero token counts.

methods.name: deriveSessionTotalTokens
methods.description: Calculates the total tokens for a session, considering usage and context tokens, with overrides for explicit prompt tokens.
